notes.title: New version of the announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone
       I'm Steve Louis, the new developer of Spark Dimension.
       I would assist Asixa to develop the Spark Dimension these days because he need to prepare his examinations this year, thank you for your support.
       We are working on designing a better Spark Dimension. 
       We will launch the Beta version in early 2018, and release the final version before September 2018.

In the coming beta version
1.There will be more interesting new items and buildings
2 There will be a new creation system that can give you a better experience
3 There will be more AI enemies and bosses. We think they will be cool.
4 There will be a new terrain generation system with different biomes and landscapes which we already done.
5 Spark Dimension will have multiplayer game system
6 Complete game plot

      You can leave comments or suggestions in community to help us make this game better
                                                                                            - Steve Louis

notes.title: Update：Alpha 1.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone, today  spark dimension updated to Alpha1.2 version This is a major update
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26280358/f2029be0af6a8fe05be8cec219a8f7e823e4c8d3.png[/img]

[H1] Language Settings [/H1]
Now you can see a language drop-down in your Steam settings window and pick from one of the available languages. The game language will be set to Steam  setting at each startup.

[H1] Store interface [/H1]
I have the spark dimension of the store interface, introduction, cover, trailer, etc. were rebuilt.

[H1] Trading cards[/H1]
Sparks dimension added 7 cards, 5 backgrounds, 5 emoji.

[H1] Achievements [/H1]
There are 14 achievements in the current spark dimension, and I will add more achievements and challenges in later updates.
The current  of these 14 achievement icons is
[B]忽如一夜春风来 千树万树梨花开[/B]
This is a Chinese ancient poetry ,

[H1] Game UI [/H1]
Reproduce 80% of the game UI

[H1] map [/H1]
Add more plants to the map

[H1] AI [/H1]
An alien crab creature

[H1] Level System [/H1]
You can upgrade to improve the ability of a certain area

[H1] Editor [/H1]
Upgrade the editor's UI and other content

[H1] More items [/H1]
Added a lot of new resources

[H1] Housing construction [/H1]
Now can be more convenient to build a house

[H1] template [/H1]
Joined the vehicle template and aircraft template, the operation more convenient

[H1] and more ... [/H1]

Thank you for your waiting and support

notes.title: Big Update：Aplha 1.0.9
notes.content:
Hello everyone, after nearly 2 months not updated, I decided to release Alpha 1.0.9
Because I am the only people to develop this game and in the development process encountered many technical problems, as well as time planning problems, So long time no update
I am not a full-time game developer, but I have put all my free time into the development of this game.

For this new version of it!
The reason is not Alpha1.10 but Alpha1.0.9 because I have two important elements not completed
You can set the game to [beta] (right click - properties - betas ) to play to Alpha1.0.9 version

[h1] What is the difference between Alpha1.0.9 and Alpha1.0.0? [/h1]

1. Unlimited random alien maps
2. The new main interface UI
3. New resources
4. optimization
5. and many more


[H1] Some minor changes: [/h1]
1. Interactive objects are highlighted
2. Remove the drop damage
3. The blocks can no longer be placed in the sky


[H1] What will Alpha1.1.0 be? [/H1]
1. More creations components
2. AI (randomly generated alien spacecraft)
3. Recalculate the weight of the creation vehicle

Thank you for the support I will release Alpha1.1.0 version as soon as possible

notes.title: Spark Dimensions will usher in a major update
notes.content:
Hi,I've done most of Alpha 1.0.1, but when I play, I find the game is not the way I want it to be. So I decided to make a major update
content include:
[list]
[*]Map Reproduction (Infinite, Random, Alien Map)
[*]UI remake
[*]AI remake
[*]Survival play remake
and many more
[/list]

The new version ([b] Alpha1.1.0[/b] ) will be updated after the Halloween sale
By then I will make two [b] new trailers[/b]  and start the first Steam visibility Round
Stay tuned

If you do not know how to change the language, there is a [Language] button in the upper left corner of the main game interface. I'll make this button more obvious in the next release

UI remake

I'll make this button more obvious in the next release
